One bounded, scrubbed canonical prepare_failure diagnostic attributes a permanent failure to the observing session instance and task claim epoch. A task row lock checks that epoch and holds it through this insert-or-update; a late completion cannot replace a newer claim diagnostic. It grants no release/reset authority, consumes no retry budget and stores no Git ref replay or duplicate integration lifecycle. Also records PREPARE_CLEANUP_HOLD when subprocess quiescence is unproved; this bounded identity/diagnostic hold prevents release or reset and is never ref replay authority.

Ordinary PREPARE_FAILURE diagnostic snapshot: one bounded secret-scrubbed stage/type/cause description plus task, observing session instance, claim epoch, workspace id and safe_text-scrubbed bounded workspace path, timestamp, attempt and the caller's already-selected disposition. Replaces the prior diagnostic call fingerprint after task/path identity was added. Cleared by the next activation; grants no retry, budget reset, ownership change, publication intent or ref replay authority and creates no duplicate integration lifecycle.
Marks claim_binding_stale for operator diagnosis when task/session binding cannot be reconciled safely; it grants no recovery or branch-write permission.
